content.content: Please show me my unread emails.

To get all the unread emails, you can use the `get_unread_emails` function:

```python
unread_emails = send_email(None, "get_unread_emails", None)
print(unread_emails)
```

This will return a list of dictionaries containing the details of each unread email. Each dictionary has fields for `sender`, `subject`, and `body`. The emails are marked as read after this function is called.
